_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I1). Ancient Tomb: '{T}: Add {C}{C}. This land deals 2 damage
to you.' -- the damage is on its ONLY ability (tap_self_damage_any_mode), not a painland's
coloured half, so even a {C} tap hurts. Board: Tamanoa, Rhox Faithmender, Vito (sick; resumed
at main 1), one untapped Ancient Tomb, empty hand. The sweep taps it: 2 damage (one event) ->
Tamanoa gains 2 -> doubled to 4 -> Vito drains 4. Us 20 -2 +4 = 22, opponent 16. Treating the
{C}{C} tap as painless (the painland reading) would leave 20/20.
